name: plugin-slot
title: PluginSlot
description: Extension point that renders plugin contributions in the light DOM, so tokens and * classes reach them. Includes getPluginHost().

a11y.pattern: Light-DOM wrapper: div.plugin-item[data-plugin-id] around each contributed element, no ARIA of its own
keyboard: Follows the contributed elements in DOM order; the slot adds no tab stop
aria: The slot adds no role or landmark: the plugin's own markup carries the semantics
Plugins style themselves with the * classes; the HTML recipes are their reference
The outlined origin label is visible text (plugin id and extension point), not color
a11y.notes: Scoped styles, no shadow root (decision D12). getPluginHost() reads globalThis.__MICROCKS_PLUGIN_HOST__ and creates it on first use, so the shell and every plugin bundle share one registry. Angular: add schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA].
